intro.heading: Who is a NIRDC Reviewer?
intro.p1: A NIRDC Reviewer is an expert panel member appointed to evaluate groundbreaking R&D proposals and shape the future of innovation in Sri Lanka. Reviewers play a critical role in identifying projects with high commercialization potential.
intro.p2: You will be responsible for providing objective, expert feedback on various proposals submitted by researchers across the country, ensuring that funding is allocated to the most deserving and impactful projects.
intro.confirm: I have completely read and understood the role of a NIRDC Reviewer.

qualifications.heading: Required Qualifications
qualifications.q1: Hold a recognized doctoral degree (Ph.D.) or equivalent in a relevant field of study.
qualifications.q2: Have a minimum of 5 years of post-doctoral research or industry experience.
qualifications.q3: Demonstrated track record of successful project management or product commercialization.
qualifications.q4: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with an ability to assess both technical merit and market viability.
qualifications.confirm: I have completely read and understood the required qualifications.

conditions.heading: Conditions to Fulfill
conditions.p1: As a Reviewer, you must agree to the following conditions before proceeding:
conditions.c1: Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all proposals and intellectual property shared with you.
conditions.c2: Declare any conflict of interest immediately upon assignment of a proposal.
conditions.c3: Complete all assigned reviews within the stipulated timeframe (usually 14 days).
conditions.c4: Provide constructive, unbiased, and evidence-based feedback on all evaluations.
conditions.c5: Attend mandatory reviewer training sessions and calibration meetings as requested by NIRDC.
conditions.confirm: I confirm that I meet and agree to fulfill all the above conditions.

video.unavailable: Training video is currently unavailable. You may proceed.

nda.heading: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
nda.p1: This Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into by and between the National Initiative for R&D Commercialisation ("NIRDC") and the undersigned Reviewer.
nda.p2: 1. Confidential Information: The Reviewer acknowledges that in the course of evaluating proposals, they will have access to proprietary and confidential information, including but not limited to business plans, financial models, intellectual property, and trade secrets.
nda.p3: 2. Non-Disclosure: The Reviewer agrees to hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence and not to disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent from NIRDC.
nda.p4: 3. Non-Use: The Reviewer agrees not to use any Confidential Information for their own benefit or the benefit of any third party.
nda.p5: 4. Return of Materials: Upon request, or after the completion of the review process, the Reviewer must destroy or return any physical or digital copies of the Confidential Information.
nda.p6: 5. Conflict of Interest: The Reviewer must immediately declare any existing or potential conflict of interest regarding any proposal assigned to them.
nda.p7: By checking the box below, you digitally sign and legally bind yourself to these terms.
nda.confirm: I accept the terms of the Non-Disclosure Agreement and legally bind myself to them.

mission.title: Mission
mission.summary: Connecting investors with market-ready research solutions through targeted mechanisms.
mission.content: To identify completed or near-completed research projects with high commercialization potential, to develop targeted mechanisms to address funding gaps, and to create a dynamic platform that connects investors with market-ready solutions.

about.title: About Us
about.description: We are a team of scientists, administrators, economists, industrialists, legal and many other subject experts, got together to build a government initiative to rapidly commercialise completed or near completed research and developments (R&D) done in Sri Lanka. While a long-term R&D mechanism is initiated at the newly formed Science and Technology ministry, we operate at the President's Secretariat to provide gap filling funding for near completed R&D projects and help investors to match completed R&D projects.
